<STRUCT_0001>
The following theorem is one of the main results of this chapter.

<LOCKED_0001>
Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme. Let <MATH_0002>
be a <MATH_0003>-morphism of stacks in groupoids over <MATH_0004>. If
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> <MATH_0005> is representable by an algebraic space, and
<STRUCT_0003> <MATH_0006> is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and
locally of finite presentation,
<STRUCT_0004>
then <MATH_0007> is an algebraic stack.

By
Lemma <REF_0001>
we see that the diagonal of <MATH_0001> is representable by algebraic
spaces. Hence we only need to verify the existence of a <MATH_0002>-morphism
<MATH_0003> of stacks in groupoids over
<MATH_0004> with <MATH_0005> representable and
<MATH_0006> surjective and smooth. By
Lemma <REF_0002>
we know that
<MATH_0007>
is an algebraic stack. It follows from
Lemma <REF_0003>
and
Algebraic Stacks,
Lemma <REF_0004>
that
<MATH_0008>
is an algebraic stack as well. Choose a representable stack in groupoids
<MATH_0009> over <MATH_0010> and a surjective and smooth
<MATH_0011>-morphism
<MATH_0012>
We claim that the composition
<MATH_0013>
is smooth and surjective which finishes the proof of the theorem. In fact,
the smoothness will be a consequence of
Lemmas <REF_0005> and <REF_0006>
and the surjectivity a consequence of
Lemma <REF_0007>.
We spell out the details in the following paragraph.

<STRUCT_0001><STRUCT_0002>
By construction <MATH_0014>
is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, and smooth (and hence
also locally of finite presentation and formally smooth by the general
principle
Algebraic Stacks, Lemma
<REF_0008>
and
More on Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0009>).
Applying
Lemmas <REF_0010>,
<REF_0011>, and
<REF_0012>
we see that <MATH_0015>
is limit preserving on objects, formally smooth on objects, and
surjective on objects. The <MATH_0016>-morphism
<MATH_0017> is
<STRUCT_0003>
<STRUCT_0004> limit preserving on objects: this is
Lemma <REF_0013>
for <MATH_0018>
and we combine it with Lemmas
<REF_0014>,
<REF_0015>, and
<REF_0016>
to get it for <MATH_0019>,
<STRUCT_0005> formally smooth on objects by
Lemma <REF_0017>,
and
<STRUCT_0006> surjective on objects by
Lemma <REF_0018>.
<STRUCT_0007>
Using
Lemmas <REF_0019>,
<REF_0020>, and
<REF_0021>
we conclude that the composition <MATH_0020> is
limit preserving on objects, formally smooth on objects, and
surjective on objects.
Using
Lemmas <REF_0022>,
<REF_0023>, and
<REF_0024>
we see that <MATH_0021> is
locally of finite presentation, formally smooth, and surjective.
Finally, using (via the general principle
Algebraic Stacks,
Lemma <REF_0025>)
the infinitesimal lifting criterion
(More on Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma
<REF_0026>)
we see that <MATH_0022> is smooth and we win.
